title: Choose jiffkit's new look
question: The roll landed on The Assembly Manual. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. Each card's picture is the homepage layout.

options.label: The Assembly Manual
options.lineage: wordless flat-pack instruction sheets and their parts lists
options.thesis: Every tool is a three-step instruction sheet: your file in, numbered steps, the result out, and nothing leaves the bench.
options.viewport: Homepage: a full-width band showing file → your device → result as a three-step diagram with a crossed-out cloud, then a parts index A–E (Image, PDF, AI, Video, Developer) listing every tool by part number.
options.risk: Turns dry or IKEA-pastiche if the drawings are clip-art; needs a consistent line-drawing language across 42 tools.

raised.raise: Traceability: every result states what happened, step by step (in 4.2 MB HEIC → out 1.1 MB JPG, 0 bytes sent).
One dominant band: the homepage's step diagram spans the full width as a single horizontal strip.
Honest verbs: controls are named for what they do (Choose, Adjust, Take), never generic labels.
A held moment: step 3 freezes before and after side by side as the page's climax.

regions.label: ① your file → ② your device → ③ result  (cloud crossed out)

options.label: The Periodic Table of Tools
options.lineage: the periodic table of the elements
options.thesis: Every tool is an element with a symbol, a number and a group colour, so all 42 read at a glance and both audiences find theirs.
options.viewport: Homepage: the whole table on one screen, 42 element tiles in group columns, a legend on top, and one large tile that shows the hovered or tapped tool with its Open button.
options.risk: Familiar: 'the periodic table of X' is a well-worn infographic trope, and symbols need a legend for first-time visitors.

regions.label: jiffkit · legend: Image PDF AI Video Developer

options.label: The Zero Readout
options.lineage: seven-segment displays: bedside clocks, price totems, scoreboards
options.thesis: A counter that never moves: every page carries a lit readout BYTES UPLOADED 0000000, and results report in LED digits.
options.viewport: Homepage: a dark panel with a giant seven-segment '0 BYTES UPLOADED' readout, tools below as labelled panel buttons.
options.case: Holds audience identification (everyone knows the readout, and it makes 'never uploaded' literal) but loses product clarity on long pages: 42 tools, FAQs and SEO text.
options.risk: A gimmick if the counter is the only idea, and a dark panel edges toward the category's 'hacker' rut.

regions.label: panel buttons: Image · PDF · AI · Video · Developer

options.label: The Street Poster
options.thesis: jiffkit as a street poster: tool names in giant condensed capitals, and the loudest word is the tool you came for.
options.viewport: Homepage: a wall of stacked tool names in condensed caps (MERGE PDF / HEIC → JPG / REMOVE BACKGROUND), each word a link, one red band reading NOTHING IS UPLOADED.
options.case: Wins on brand feel and memorability, which fixes 'generic', but loses product clarity on tool pages, where the task must lead.
options.risk: Loud: tool pages must quiet down hard or the task drowns, and it needs a self-hosted condensed display font.

options.label: Punched-card Brocade
options.lineage: jacquard looms driven by punched cards
options.thesis: Every conversion shown as instruction rows weaving into a finished motif.
options.viewport: Instruction rows above, the woven result below.
options.case: Developers might see binary in it; everyday visitors would not, and it says nothing about files.
options.kept: Traceability: every result now states what happened, step by step.
options.risk: Ornate and opaque for a quick task.

options.label: The Indoor Sun
options.lineage: an amber half-sun in a misty hall
options.thesis: One vast hazy hall; visitors walk toward the light.
options.viewport: A single horizontal band with a half sun.
options.case: Beautiful but carries neither tools nor privacy.
options.kept: One dominant band: the step diagram spans the full width.

options.label: Ink Basin
options.thesis: The page as a live fluid surface.
options.viewport: A full-screen ink basin that answers the pointer.
options.case: Breaks the 15 KB script budget and says nothing about files.
options.kept: Honest verbs: controls named for what they do.

options.label: Painted Film Hoarding
options.thesis: One held moment, painted at full drama.
options.viewport: A frozen leap with a vertical title.
options.case: Neither audience sees their task in it.
options.kept: A held moment: step 3 freezes before and after side by side.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What iLovePDF and Smallpdf ship: a clean grid of coloured tool cards, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: A headline, category chips and a grid of icon cards: the arrangement visitors already expect.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design, which is the problem you named.
